text:
The ultimate SEO checklist for a local business:

Main Google category matches what customers type.
Listed hours are the hours you answer the phone.
A new Google review every week.
One website page for every service.

Do these four first. Everything else comes after.

Plumber in Rockingham downloads a 120-point SEO checklist.

Ticks off nine items. Never opens it again.

A short checklist you finish beats a long one you abandon.

Start with three: the right main category on Google, your real hours, a review request after every job.

30 Google reviews in one month, then a year of silence.
Or one review every week.

One a week wins. Experts scoring Google Maps ranking factors put fresh reviews and a steady flow of reviews in their top 15.

Text your review link after every job.
